name: Moog Subsequent 37
description: Moog Subsequent 37 paraphonic analog synthesizer: the CC table and the NRPN chart of its manual.

sources.title: Subsequent 37 Manual
sources.notes: MIDI CC table (pages 53, 54, 55) and NRPN chart (pages 56, 57, 58, 59) read by tools/profiles/moog/read-moog-pdf.mjs from Subsequent_37_Manual_0.pdf (sha256 eb6778e3d8d6bb6823cb0b1a53719a38c0ecdecfcf38d69f4d4d9c82de17e940), https://cdn.inmusicbrands.com/Moog/Subsequent37/Subsequent_37_Manual_0.pdf. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/moog/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/moog/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is a row of the manual's MIDI tables, with its printed name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
No identity check: the manual prints no Device Inquiry reply.

The CC table and the NRPN chart are both here: the panel sends CCs or NRPNs as its KNB NRPN/CC setting says, and the NRPN chart reaches every setting, the CCs only some. The NRPN parameters are grouped apart, `(NRPN)` after the group.
When an LFO is synced, its rate controller (CC 3, CC 8) selects a clock division instead; the manual's table of those (p. 52) is not a setting of its own and is not read.

28 knob(s) are printed as an MSB and an LSB, 0 - 16383 together; CEditor sends the MSB alone, 0 - 127, which the manual says the instrument takes by itself: MOD WHEEL (CC 1, LSB 33); LFO 1 RATE (CC 3, LSB 35); MOD 1 PITCH AMT (CC 4, LSB 36); GLIDE TIME (CC 5, LSB 37); MASTER VOLUME (CC 7, LSB 39); LFO 2 RATE (CC 8, LSB 40); OSC 1 WAVE (CC 9, LSB 41); MOD 1 FILTER AMT (CC 11, LSB 43); OSC 2 FREQ (CC 12, LSB 44); OSC 2 BEAT FREQ (CC 13, LSB 45); OSC 2 WAVE (CC 14, LSB 46); MOD 2 PITCH AMT (CC 15, LSB 47); MOD 2 FILTER AMT (CC 16, LSB 48); MOD 2 PGM DEST AMT (CC 17, LSB 49); FILTER MULTIDRIVE (CC 18, LSB 50); FILTER CUTOFF (CC 19, LSB 51); MOD 1 PGM DEST AMT (CC 20, LSB 52); FILTER RESONANCE (CC 21, LSB 53); FILTER KB AMT (CC 22, LSB 54); FILTER EG ATTACK TIME (CC 23, LSB 55); FILTER EG DECAY TIME (CC 24, LSB 56); FILTER EG SUSTAIN TIME (CC 25, LSB 57); FILTER EG RELEASE TIME (CC 26, LSB 58); FILTER EG AMT (CC 27, LSB 59); AMP EG ATTACK TIME (CC 28, LSB 60); AMP EG DECAY TIME (CC 29, LSB 61); AMP EG SUSTAIN TIME (CC 30, LSB 62); AMP EG RELEASE TIME (CC 31, LSB 63).
Left out, MIDI's own controller (bank select), not a setting: BANK SELECT (CC 0), BANK SELECT [LSB] (CC 32).

Left out, printed as reserved, or without a name: RESERVED - MIDI BREATH CTRL (CC 2 [MSB], 34 [LSB]), RESERVED - DATA ENTRY (CC 6 [MSB], 38 [LSB]), RESERVED - MIDI PAN (CC 10 [MSB], 42 [LSB]), RESERVED PORTAMENTO CONTROL (CC 84), RESERVED DATA INCREMENT (CC 96), RESERVED DATA DECREMENT (CC 97), RESERVED NRPN LSB (CC 98), RESERVED NRPN MSB (CC 99), RESERVED RPN LSB (CC 100), RESERVED RPN MSB (CC 101), (RESERVED) (NRPN 414), (RESERVED) (NRPN 415), (RESERVED) (NRPN 429), (RESERVED) (NRPN 431), (RESERVED) (NRPN 432), (RESERVED) (NRPN 433), (unnamed) (NRPN 434), (RESERVED) (NRPN 434), (RESERVED) (NRPN 439), (RESERVED) (NRPN 454), (RESERVED) (NRPN 456), (RESERVED) (NRPN 457), (RESERVED) (NRPN 458), (RESERVED) (NRPN 459), (RESERVED) (NRPN 464), (RESERVED) (NRPN 473), (RESERVED) (NRPN 474), (RESERVED) (NRPN 475), (RESERVED) (NRPN 476), (RESERVED) (NRPN 477), (RESERVED) (NRPN 478), (RESERVED) (NRPN 519), (RESERVED) (NRPN 521), (RESERVED) (NRPN 522), (RESERVED) (NRPN 523), (RESERVED) (NRPN 524).
Left out, MIDI's own controller (a channel mode message), not a setting: LOCAL CONTROL ON/OFF (CC 122), ALL NOTES OFF (CC 123).

Left out, its number of values printed out of step with the rows around it (OSC 2 DUO MODE with 16384, OSC 2 FREQUENCY with 3, OSC 2 BEAT and OSC 1 LEVEL with 2, OSC 1 ON with 21): OSC 2 DUO MODE (NRPN 486), OSC 2 FREQUENCY (NRPN 487), OSC 2 BEAT (NRPN 488), OSC 1 LEVEL (NRPN 489), OSC 1 ON (NRPN 490).
Left out, a range printed as the value shown, not the value sent: KB TRANSPOSE (CC 119): RECEIVE ONLY: -12...+13 SEMITONES.
Left out, printed without its number of values: FILTER RESONANCE (NRPN 500).
Each NRPN is sent with its number split as MIDI splits one (MSB n / 128, LSB n % 128) and its value as one 14-bit number, data entry MSB on CC 6 then LSB on CC 38.
